title: Cloud City: Case Study: Helicopter Racing League — Video Streaming & Real-Time ML

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Airships were racing across the mountain valley, but spectators in the town square could only see distant specks and had no idea who was winning.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Broadcaster Brian mounted signal mirrors on airships (Video Feeds) and set up relay towers (Cloud CDN) beaming live flags to every street corner.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: Brian hired an actuary (Vertex AI) who calculated wind drift to announce the winner 30 seconds before the final turn.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Signal mirrors are obscured by fog; digital video streaming over cloud CDN reaches millions of devices simultaneously in 4K.
